tasks.analysis: TechTron, a top computer manufacturing and software company, was recently brought under fire for not allowing their consumers to use competitors' web browsers on TechTron computers. This was seen as their attempt to use their dominant position in the market to keep out competitors. TechTron admitted to the accusation. However, the company explained that this was to give customers the best possible experience using their computers. Nonetheless, TechTron is now required to allow a choice of alternative, non - TechTron web browsers on their computers. TechTron 是一家顶尖的计算机制造与软件公司，近期因不允许消费者在其生产的电脑上使用竞争对手的网页浏览器而遭到强烈批评。此举被认为是该公司试图利用其在市场中的主导地位排挤竞争对手。TechTron 承认了这一指控，但解释称这样做是为了让客户获得尽可能好的电脑使用体验。尽管如此，该公司现在已被要求允许用户在其电脑上选择使用其他非 TechTron 品牌的网页浏览器。
